notes.title: Islands of Insight | Offline Mode Release Date
notes.notes:
Seekers, we are so happy to announce that our Offline Mode will be released on July 9! 

This addition provides you, our dedicated players, and new players with more flexibility in how you enjoy the islands and our beautiful puzzles. 

Play Anywhere‍ 

With our Offline Mode, you no longer need to be tethered to an internet connection. You can experience Islands of Insight without worrying about unreliable connection and delays. 
 
A Mode Brimming With Puzzles 

Our offline mode is brimming with puzzles. The mode has the same biomes and puzzles quantity and diversity as the online version. Puzzles will also respawn, and you will be able to do daily quests. 

What to Expect‍ 

Our goal is to have a similar experience between the online mode and the offline version. It's important to understand that any social / online functionality, like emoting or pinging other players will not be available in this mode. With this mode being exclusively available in single player, some content has been balanced, modified or removed. 

If you have been playing the game online, and want to switch to offline, don’t worry, you will be able to save your progression and transfer it over to Offline Mode.  

 

One last thing. The base game is available for FREE (to keep forever!) for 24 hours – so until tomorrow, June 27 at 1pm ET. This is your sign to join other Seekers and get your puzzle-solving on.  

See you on the islands!

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Patch Notes - Version 1.1.0b
notes.notes:
Hello Seekers, 

Today we released an update with new content and technical improvements! Read below for details: 

New Content 

Added The Archipelago of Curiosities—a large bonus endgame Enclave featuring some unusual and creative twists on your favourite puzzles. The entrance is off to the side of the Haven of Insight along the path toward Serene Deluge. 

Added new grid rules and a new grid symbol. Awaken them by completing Bent Into Shape and Nearsighted—two new challenges in Autumn Falls and Serene Deluge respectively. New puzzles using each rule will spawn daily in the areas surrounding those challenges. 

Added Two for One, Cross the Streams, Found the Difference, The Puzzle Cube, and See Serpents—five new themed logic grid challenges spread across the map. 

Added Ground Away—a tricky group of Pillars of Insight in Serene Deluge. 

Added a fresh pack of high-difficulty logic grids along the path between the Haven of Insight and the entrance to Shattered Library. There are now 5 spawn locations for these difficult puzzles instead of 3. 

Added a new set of Black Iris wings for all players! Please note, these will be automatically added to your inventory!  

Finally, a somewhat unusual area has appeared beneath the Haven of Insight. 

Bug Fixes 


 Fixed progression blockers. 
 Echoes of Time should no longer be locked after a game relaunch. 
 Armillary Rings should now spawn as intended (flat ring bug). 
 Unlocked Ethereal Glow hair will no longer appear locked when relaunching the game. 
 To those who experienced the Ethereal Glow hair bug, please note that we will be adding the accessory back into your inventory on 04.17 after 3 PM ET. 
 The number of solved puzzles in the Vault of Vitric will now accurately be displayed in the Quest Log. 
 Players should no longer be randomly kicked from parties. 
 Additional fixes to the Friends List social feature. 
 Additional performance and graphical improvements. 


Known Issues 

General

 A Party leader is unable to disband the party by leaving it from the Pause Menu. 
 Some Friends’ avatar icons may be corrupted.
 Using the “I’m Stuck” button during a short blackout animation from Fast Travel may cause the screen to stay black.
 Teleporting to Warp Beacon while using zoom function may lock the Player’s zoomed-in screen after the teleport.

Location 

 Archipelago of Curiosity  
 Quest inside the Enclave is displayed on the map. 
 “100% Complete!” text is not displayed in the quest log once the Enclave is maxed out.
 Lucent Waters
 Gather No Moss – Multiple Rolling Block puzzles in the location do not zoom in correctly when using ultrawide screen. 

Map

 The icon on the map for “A Snake in the Grass” (Serene Deluge) is the same for a completion and 100% completion. 
 The challenge “The Flames of the Enlightenment” shows “0/0” Puzzles being available.

Daily Quests

 The following quests do not display the number of puzzles to solve: 
 “Solve Flow Orbs and Glide Rings”, “Solve Light Motifs and Crystal Labyrinths”, “Solve Perspective Puzzles”, and “Solve Environmental Puzzles”.


Thank you for your support!
The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Patch Notes - Version 1.0.13a
notes.notes:
Hello Seekers, 

Today we released a new patch that addresses various issues. Please see details below. 

General game fixes 

 Fixed an issue affecting some players where selecting Play Game would result in a crash and UE4 crash report.
 Improved server synchronization. 
 Improvements to reported rubber banding and server connection issues. 
 Players previously unable to complete Enclaves, and hence blocked in their campaign, should now be unblocked. 
 Enclave progress will no longer reset upon launch.  
 Each zone on the map will now display the correct Mirabilis count. 
 Customization items that could previously not be unlocked, are now available and displaying as intended. 
 Wing unlock now behaving as intended. 
 Fixes to Party features, including pings and emotes now behaving and appearing as intended. 
 Several graphical & interactive (collision/clipping) fixes. 
 Naming discrepancies between different areas in the game and menus have been fixed. 
 Unlocking secrets and opening secret animations in the Encyclopedia no longer cause issues. 


Puzzle specific fixes 

 For those impacted, Rolling Block puzzles are now available in the Enclave, Gather No Moss. Completing the Enclave will now also display information about unlocking this puzzle type. 
 Sentinel Stone pillars now appear as intended in the environment. 
 Solving puzzles in The Temple of Infinite Rings will now impact your quest log and progress will not reset. 
 Invisible wall is no longer present in one of The Glass Temple’s Crystal Labyrinth. 
 Skydrop mastery now impacted by the Skydrop Combo.
 Holding X to reset (Glide Rings, Crystal Labyrinth) now works as intended. 


Thank you all for your patience and support, and if you experience any other issues, please be sure to contact our support team here:  https://islands-of-insight.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Hotfix 1.0.12c.
notes.notes:
Addendum

 Hotfix name updated to include full version: 1.0.1. to 1.0.12c. 
 Wording edits to more clearly describe the player experience.

______________
Seekers, we've just released a patch to resolve progression-related issues. For impacted players, you may experience the following:

 Players who encountered progression issues may get a mirabilis or the upgrade tutorial as soon as they load in - possibly even during the loading screen. 
 Players that were blocked by not completing The Empyrean Journey or not unlocking their wings, will have the wings unlock cutscene play, without their Seeker, as soon as the Enclave is entered, or the game is loaded. 


Please also note that affected players will need to re-enter any Enclaves that were previously not responding to progress to trigger completion of any objectives that are required for the campaign. This will not occur automatically. 

We thank you for your support and cooperation, 

The IOI Team

notes.title: Islands of Insight | Release Date, Steam Next Fest & More!
notes.notes:
Hello Seekers! 

We’ve got a lot of exciting news to share today.

First, Islands of Insight will be released February 13th on Steam! Thousands of hand-crafted puzzles and countless hours of gameplay await you! Be sure to Wishlist to get notified as soon as the game is live. 

In the meantime, get the deepest look yet at Islands of Insight below. Get a glimpse of some of the game’s different puzzles, its world, player progression, and overall gameplay experience, in this extensive look from game director Elyot Grant.

[previewyoutube=8JmHrUIZsMI;full][embed video][/previewyoutube]
If February 13th is too long to wait (and we can’t blame you), you’ll have the chance to play Islands of Insight’s brand new demo during Steam Next Fest February 5-12th. Our new demo will allow you to explore a portion of the game to your heart’s content and, excitingly, your progress WILL carry over into the full game.

To start solving even earlier, sign up here to get early access to the demo and to explore, discover, and solve before everyone else. Demo keys will be emailed out twice daily from February 2nd-4th, so sign up now to make sure you get yours. 

Follow us on X and TikTok for even more.

There’s never been a better time to be a puzzle fan.

We’ll see you on the Islands February 5th (or earlier 😉),

The IOI Team
